questions.sourceFile: 上海市虹口区2014届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc

questions.sourceFile: 上海市长宁区2014届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: Mr. King doesn’t know what time _______ back home yesterday evening.
questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句语序和时态；what time 引导宾语从句，从句用陈述语序，yesterday evening 对应用过去时。

questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句连接词，根据语义用if表示“是否”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市虹口区2015届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: No matter how much you think you hate school, you will still miss it ______ you leave it. A) when B) unless C) until D) since
questions.topicReason: 考查状语从句连词辨析，when 引导时间状语从句，表示“当……时”。

questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句语序和疑问词选择；回答For fifteen minutes对应how long，且从句用陈述语序。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市虹口区2016届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: As I have something to tell him, I will wait he comes back. A) until B) as soon as C) when D) after
questions.topicReason: 考查时间状语从句连词，wait until表示“等到……”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市嘉定区2018届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: We all believe you will succeed in working out the problems ____ you give up.
questions.topicReason: 考查条件状语从句连词 unless，表示“除非”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市嘉定区2018届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc

options.A: how long she has gone to Hong Kong
options.B: how long she has been in Hong Kong

options.D: how long she has been to Hong Kong

questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句语序及 how long 与延续性表达的搭配，应使用陈述语序并用 has been in。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市奉贤区2018届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc

options.A: how can I get to the supermarket
options.B: how could I get to the supermarket
options.C: how I can get to the supermarket
options.D: how I could get to the supermarket

questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句语序，疑问词引导的宾语从句要用陈述语序：how I can get...。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市崇明区2018届九年级上学期期末（一模）质量监控英语试题及答案（word版）.doc
questions.prompt: _____ you know how harmful smoking is, you’d better get rid of it immediately.
questions.topicReason: 考查状语从句连词辨析，Since 表示“既然”，引导原因状语从句。

questions.prompt: Professor Li wanted to know ________.
questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句语序和时态，宾语从句用陈述语序，主句过去时从句用过去将来时。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市崇明区2020-2021学年九年级上学期期末（一模）英语试题（解析版）.doc
questions.prompt: I can't tell whether she is old or young, ________ I have never seen her.

questions.sourceFile: 上海市普陀区2020-2021学年九年级上学期期末（一模）英语试题（解析版）.doc
questions.prompt: ________ any one of you has a question, you may ask after class.
questions.topicReason: 考查条件状语从句引导词 if，表示“如果”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市长宁区2020-2021学年九年级上学期期末（一模）英语试题（解析版）.doc
questions.prompt: I won’t believe Tony is able to recite the long boring poem ________ I have tested him myself.
questions.topicReason: 考查 not...until... 结构，表示“直到……才……”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市静安区2020-2021学年九年级上学期期末（一模）英语试题（解析版）.doc
questions.prompt: You will really never know what happiness is ________ you have something to compare it to.
questions.topicReason: 考查条件状语从句连词辨析；句意为“除非有东西可比较，否则你不会真正知道幸福是什么”，应用 unless。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市黄浦区2020-2021学年九年级上学期期末（一模）英语试题（解析版）.doc
questions.prompt: I choose to believe the story, ________ there is a lot of debate over whether there actually was Trojan War.
questions.topicReason: 考查让步状语从句。前后为让步关系，although 表示“尽管”。

questions.topicReason: 句意为“否则你们就会违法”，if not在此表示条件转折含义，考查连接关系。

questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2023年上海市长宁区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Please tell me the truth, ________ I can know what suggestions to give you.
questions.topicReason: 考查并列连词 and，连接顺承关系。

questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2023年上海市青浦区中考一模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Andy still doesn’t know how to solve the math problem, ________ you’d better explain it again.
questions.topicReason: 前后分句是因果关系，考查并列连词 so 表示“所以”。

questions.sourceFile: 上海市金山区2023-2024学年九年级上学期（一模）期末英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: ________ we often meet inside the lift, we really don’t know each other.

options.D: If 【答案】B 【详解】句意：虽然我们经常在电梯里见面，但我们真的不认识对方。 考查让步状语从句。Because因为；Although虽然；Until直到；If如果。根据“we often meet inside the lift,”以及“we really don’t know each other.”可知该句存在让步关系，although符合语境。故选B。

questions.topicReason: 考查 although 引导让步状语从句。

questions.sourceFile: 2026上海崇明初三一模英语试卷（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: —Excuse me, could you tell me ________ I can get to the library? —Sure. Go straight and turn left at the end of the road. You’ll see the library there.
questions.topicReason: 考查宾语从句连接词；根据答语指路可知询问“怎样到图书馆”，用how。
